name: 💥(NEW) Drain City
desc:
❗ Survive in a dangerous sewer where everyone is your enemy. Find your path in life as either a Dweller or Police. Make sure to make good choices, because one choice could be your worst mistake. ❗

✅ GAME IS BACK! Use code FIREDDEVELOPER for 10,000 CASH! ✅

📣 (Exiting the game In Combat will cause you to lose 50 respect. If you see a Red Gun in the bottom left you are In Combat.) 

🔒 Store your items you don't want to lose in your safe, located on the table inside the Bank. (VIP SERVERS DO NOT SAVE)

💸 Spend your cash to unlock vehicles, weapons, and powerful stomp effects.

💀 You can Stomp and Arrest players who are rag-dolled (at 0 health). See game controls below. 

[PC] 💻
E: Stomp
F: Drop Tool
R: Reload
Shift: Sprint
Ctrl: Lock Camera

[Controller] 🎮 
D-Pad Left: Drop Item
D-Pad Down: Stomp
D-Pad Up: Drag
X: Reload
Left Thumbstick: Run
Y: Lock Camera

[Mobile] 📱
Follow the on-screen button diagrams for all actions.

⚠️ NOTICE: Cheaters will be permanently banned.
